tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang 'char ka'i nyi ma ltar dmar ba// mi shes ldongs pa'i 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig pu rab tu dpa'// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas ni mgon po de'i// mnyes bya'i rim pa dang por ldan pa bdag gis bri bar bya// rigs pa 'dzin pas yid 'ong shin tu dben pa'i gnas// gang yang rung bar 'jam pa'i stan la rab 'dug la// 'gro ba'i mi shes bsal phyir 'jam dbyangs nyid bya zhes// mnyam med byang chub sems ni rnam par bsgom par bya// de yi rjes su snying nang pad+ma zla dbus su// bzhi pa'i bzhi pa nga ro bzhi dang bcu drug ldan// gur gum mdog 'dra yid kyi sgrib sel bsam de yi// 'od kyis lus kun rab gang dag pa'i shel ltar bsam// de ma thag tu rang nyid mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// lang tsho rgyas shing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i tshul 'chang ba// gser bsregs mdog 'dra kun nas 'od rab gsal ba'i sku// sgeg cing mdzes pa'i sku ni brjid cing 'gying bag can// spyan yangs zur gyis gzigs shing cung zad bzhad cing 'dzum// zur phud lnga ldan snyan gong ut+pal dar dpyangs can// rin chen cod pan 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pas mdzes// dpa' bo thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyab tu bsil zer can// sna tshogs dar bsnams rin chen rgyan kun 'od 'bar ba// ut+pal glegs bam ral gri rab tu 'dzin pa'i phyag /chu skyes zla dbus skyil mo krung gis legs bzhugs shing*// sna tshogs 'od kyis mkha' kun 'gengs par bsam par bya// de las sngar gsungs yi ges dbus mtshan ri bong can// pad+ma la gnas snying dbus nges bsam yig 'bru'i mthar// sngon du oṃ sngags a ra pa tsa na dhīḥdagod// lce la yang ni mdzes pa'i dhīḥyig gis mtshan te// de ltar yi ge'i tshogs kun rin chen sgron me ltar// rab tu gsal zhing 'bar bltas g.yeng ba bral bas bzlas// de mthar rang lus dmar gsal rab tu brjid pa'i dhīḥ// der gtad yid kyis srog gcig brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas// dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can rnams la rgya cher bsngo// langs nas 'jam dpal nyid yin bsam nas mchod cing bstod// 'khrig dang brdzun sogs mi dge kun dang chang la sogs// dme bag zas kun spangs te rig pa'i rgyal po bsgrub// gnam lcags rlung drag gcan zan la sogs mtshan ma ngan// gal te mthong na khro bo'i rgyal pos shin tu bsrung*// ral gri ut+pal bsril zhing 'bar ba'i me sogs mtshan// mthong na grub nyi'i ltas su mkhas pas shes par bya// bzang dang bzang min ngan dang ngan min kun spangs te// rtse gcig nyid du g.yeng bral thun bzhi'i rim nges pa// gang gis lo phyed rgyun mi 'chad par 'bad pa'am// 'bum phrag brgyad brjod pas ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur// de ma thag tu thub dka'i rtsod las rgyal 'gyur zhing*// 'gran zla med pa'i snyan ngag mkhan tu yang ni 'gyur// tshigs bcad brgya ni de yi mod la byed cing smra// gzhan yang yid la 'dod pa ma lus nges 'grub pa'o// rtog pa'i rlung spangs bla ma'i lung nyid las// bsdebs legs ngag gis brgyan pa 'di byas pa'i// dge ba gang thob des ni 'gro ba kun// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid 'grub par shog
/a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba

dpe la lar bsod nams rtse mos mdzad ces pa'ang snang*/ rdzogs so// ༈ /'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i brgyud pa ni byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ de'i slob ma ni byang chub sems dpa' dze tā ri/ de'i slob ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ de'i slob ma rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ de la bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas gsan/ de la bla ma chen po sa skya pas gsan/ de la chos rje rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can gyis gsan/ de dag thams cad kyis ni 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs pa yin no zhes grags so// yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs du ma dag kyang snang ngo*// de ltar grub pa'i brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsgrub par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas thog mar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims la gnas par byas nas/ sha dang chang dang*/ bud med dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ 'bags pa ma lus pa spangs nas/ yid dga' ba'i gnas su stan bde ba la bsdad la/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal la/ 'jam dpal gyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de'i rjes la rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba de'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser gur gum gyi mdog 'dra ba de las 'od byung nas lus thams cad khyab pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom ste/ dri ma med pa'i shel ltar gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na mi shes pa gcod pa'i ral gri/ g.yon na ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung nas rna ba'i thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa'o// zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ ral pa'i cod pan steng du bcings pa'am ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba'i sku gsal bar bsgom par bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo bar gyur na/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser gyi mtha' ma nas phar oṃ a ra pa tsa na zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ lce'i rtsa bar dhīḥmago phugs su bstan/ nyal thabs su 'dug pa la dmigs pa gtad nas/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o// thun 'jog pa'i dus su dbugs thog gcig la/ dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de ltar ma grub na'ang gtam mi bya bar bzla'o// de nas lus dhīḥr gyur par bsam mo// dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// bar chad kyi rtags ni thog ser 'bab pa dang*/ rlung dang gcan gzan gyis zos pa la sogs pa byung na bar chad kyi rtags yin pas mi g.yo ba la sogs pa'i khro bo'i sngags bzla bar bya'o// ral gri dang ut+pal 'dzin pa dang*/ me 'bar ba la sogs pa byung na grub pa'i rtags su shes par bya'o// zla ba drug gam 'bum phrag brgyad cu bzlas pas thog mar 'dzin blo skye bar 'gyur ro// de nas snyan ngag dang rdo rje'i ngag dang phyin ci ma log pa'i don phun sum tshogs par skye bar 'gyur ro// g.yeng bas mi 'grub ste/ mdor na sems rtse gcig par bsgoms na 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gsal byed shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan blo gros dhīḥlas byung ba gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang mdzes pa'i sku// chu skyes bsil zer can dbus skyil mo krung bcas kun nas rol pa'i 'gying bag can// gur gum mdog can zur phud lnga pa snyan gong ut+pal gyis mdzes shing*// sna tshogs rin chen rab spras lha yi na bzas smad g.yogs legs par bgos// phyag g.yas mkha' ltar sngo ba'i ral gri tsha zer can 'od rab 'phros pas// mun pa'i 'thibs po drang cing bdud bcom de bzhin nyid don thugs chud cing*// g.yon gyi ut+pal 'dab brgyad rnam rgyal mgul pa'i ngos su rab rgyas pa// ge sar snying po dri med steng na rgyal ba'i gsung rab glegs bam bsnams// khyod gtsug mi bskyod skyob pas rab mtshan rdo rje rnon po'i yi ge drug

/bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs can gyi zhabs rdul yid 'ong kho bo'i spyi bor zhog /khyod sku bdag lus snying gi 'khor lor rnam bsams gang gi chags sdang sogs// ngan sems tha chad dam pas smad pa de kun mgon pos bzod mdzod cig /rgyal sras thu bo'i rnam thar zab cing rgya che bdag la nyer stsol mdzod// yab gcig nyid las lha gzhan dag la re ba ma mchis skal ngan bdag /nyin mtshan kun tu 'jam dbyangs gus pas bsams kyang khyed kyi thugs rjes shugs// cung zad med snyam 'on kyang byur ngan rang gi nyes pas bslad par zad// da dung khyod mnyes ma gyur bar du skyabs gzhan 'tshol bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs blo 'phel gser gyi phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo mañju nā thā ya/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo madz+nyu gho ṣā ya/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros nang gi mun pa dang*/ tha mal gyi lus bsregs sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa gsal nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan mkhyen rab byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang sems dhīḥyig la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar ser sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa ser po/ lte bar g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon du a/ rtsibs la mdun nas g.yas skor du ra pa tsa na gnas pa/ dhīḥlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhī ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying ga'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs te 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad sngags phreng dang*/ 'od zer ser po'i rnam par byung*/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci mang bzla/

rang gi lce'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan nas nyal thabs su gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par bsams te/ dbug thog gcig la dhīḥthon tshad brjod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas// ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin// gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thums sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// 'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsungs// 'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing*// ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams// gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku// bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid ni// gegs med par ni mthong bar shog /brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol// shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas// 'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar// bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid kyis// bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol// gang gi mkhyen rab nyi ma stong bas kyang*// ches cher gsal bas 'gro ba'i ma rig pa// drungs nas 'byin mdzad lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bdag gi snying la rgyun du 'jug gyur cig

/gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi// ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar// dbyangs can ma de'ang kho bo yi// yid la ring du rol bar mdzod// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /swa nap+tā wā gin+d+ra s+yā r+the ṣu bhū mi paṇa du ka lo tsā s+ya li khi taṃ/ rang gi tsha bo ngag gi dbang po'i don du sa skya lo tsā bas bris // ༈ /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang byed tshul gcig shes kun khyab bzhugs/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang la/ tshom bu dang mchod gtor bsham pa/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ gtor ma 'bul ba sogs spyi ltar grub nas/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te gral la 'khod pa dang me tog bkye bsdu byas rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i a ra pa tsa na la rgyas par na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ bsdus pa gtso bo rkyang pa'i rjes su gnang ba gnyis las/ da res rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol bzhin/ rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa 'khor dang bcas pa da res nas kyi gnas skabs su song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs gnyis su med par rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad par zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa dang*/ rjes gnang dngos gnyis las/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bu zhig tu gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa nas shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis tha mal gyi snang ba mi dmigs te stong nyid du sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can de yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal sogs nas thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gsal btab/

slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi bar bsam gyis mi khyab par byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams dang ba spu bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥsogs dang*/ ā be sha la aḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pa bya/ de rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa yin/ da rjes gnang dngos la rjes su bzlas pa'i lung*/ dam bca' ba'i lung*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung rnams su yod pa las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dang slob dpon gnyis ka rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon du a/ rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du ra pa tsa na zhes pa rnams 'khod par mos nas slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la/ dang pos thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes dang*/ slar yang khyed rang rnams dang*/ slob dpon gnyis ka rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs su gsal ba'i lce steng du dhīḥyig dmar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan pa re re yod par mos pa mdzad nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/

slob dpon gyi dhīḥyig las dhī yig dpag tu med par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dhī yig la thim pas/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos nas dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad gsungs mdzod/ dhīḥdhīḥdhīḥsogs brjod/ khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyi me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes lan gsum tsam brjod nas me tog slob ma la gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// zhes dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs yi dam kyi lhar bzung zhing*/ de'i gsang sngags kyang ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus da nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing*/ de'i gsang sngags kyang ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ yang me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i dhīḥyig la thim pas byin gyis brlabs te chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de rnams kyis rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi song nas/ de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma la lus longs spyod la sogs pa yon tu 'bul zhing*/ cha shas kyis longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad sogs bya/

slob dpon gyis rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang byed tshul 'di nyid ni swa nap+tā wā gin+d+ra s+yā r+the ṣu bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ga lo tsā na s+ya li khi taṃ/ rang gi tsha bo ngag gi dbang po'i don du sa skya lo tsās bris/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsgom pa 'dod pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyer gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya mañju shrī bh+yaḥ.oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil gyi steng du dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan mkhyen brtse spobs pa gzungs la sogs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas dhīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mgul rgyan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa ser po'i lte bar g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon du a/ rtsibs rnams la mdun nas g.yas skor du ra pa tsa na gnas pa'i/ dhī las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ro bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ snying ga'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs te/ 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par byung nas shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ rang gi lce steng du dhīḥdamar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan la nyal thabs su gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par bsam ste/ dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa gcig bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ ar+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab rgyas shing*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod cing*/ spro na/ gang gi blo gros sogs kyis bstod la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu gcig bkod/

de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod phyogs mtshams su bsham/ shar mdun du gtor ma zlum po gcig dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs la ting shag me tog gi snod/ slob ma la dgos pa'i me tog maṇ+ḍal/ dri bzang po sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa ni slob dpon gyis/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā ba sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ mthar ting shag dkrol te byin dbab/ bdag bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas 'god par shog gi bar gong ltar bya'o// mdun bskyed ni/ bsang sbyangs gong ltar bya/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gi bar gong bzhin las/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ ting shag rdung zhing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs nas dbur brgyan par gong bzhin/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs gyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa bzlas gsol gdab snga ma ltar bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i dam pa'i chos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i yon tan dang thugs rje mnga' ba de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na/ mngon pa mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes gsungs te/ 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen po tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs/ zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs/ gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs pa yin/ 'o na sngags kyi theg pa sde snod gsum gang du 'du zhe na/

slob dpon chen po a bha ya ni bslab pa gsum ka ston pas sde snod gsum ka'o zhes bzhed/ slob dpon shān+ti pas zab mo'i don bsdus te ston pas mdo sde'i sde snod yin no gsungs shing*/ slob dpon ār+ya de was rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang*/ zhes sde snod bzhi par bzhed do// yang gdul bya dman pa la mos par nyan thos kyi sde snod dang*/ rgya chen po la mos par theg pa chen po'i sde snod gsungs so// de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ mdo sde la sogs pa chos rgya chen po la dmigs pas dmigs pa che ba/ rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub pas sgrub pa che ba/ rtogs pa'i dus na bdag med gnyis rtogs pas ye shes che ba/ grangs med gsum du gus par byas te sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rtsom pas brtson 'grus che ba/ 'khor ba mi gtong zhing kun nas nyon mongs pas mi gos pas thabs rgya che ba ste rgyu'i khyad par lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la sogs pa 'grub pas yang dag grub pa che ba dang*/ yang dang yang du byang chub pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las chen po ste/ 'bras bu'i khyad par gnyis dang bcas pa'i sgo nas theg pa chen po khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces gsungs pa'i theg chen gyi sde snod la dbye na/ gdul bya dbang po rtul po rgyu la mos pa'i dbang du byas nas rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ dbang po rnon po rgyu 'bras lhun grub la mos pa'i dbang du byas nas 'bras bu lam du byed pa sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa yin te/

rgyu la mos par rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'gyur bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs la/ de las sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ tshul gsum gyi sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rtogs bya lta ba don gcig pa dang*/ thob bya 'bras bu don gcig pas/ nyams len spyod pa don gcig tu zin kyang*/ rtogs pa'i lta ba la ma rmongs pa dang*/ thabs mang ba dang*/ dka' ba med pas byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ stong nyid snying rje sogs bsgom pa// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs yin// de yis ji ltar myur na yang*// grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad dgos// zhes dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i gnad shes na// tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub// ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ de la yang rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa dang*/ gsum du 'dod pa dang*/ bzhir 'dod pa dang*/ lngar 'dod pa dang*/ drug tu 'dod pa rnams yod pa las/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhir 'dod pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag dman pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba la bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ gang zag 'bring phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa la spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ gang zag mchog ting nge 'dzin kho na la gtso bor spyod pa la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ gang zag ches mchog tu gyur pa ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med par spyod pa la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs pa las 'dir spyod pa'i rgyud yin/

de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la'ang du ma yod pa'i nang nas 'dir 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang bcas pa'i lugs srol gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir grub chen dze tā ri nas brgyud/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba nas rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i rje btsun 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes su gnang ba'i sngon du 'gro ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dgos pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin snyam pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa byas nas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs par mos te/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'khor 'das gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las/ sogs nas/ ra pa tsa na gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ting shag dkrol zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes yang yang brjod do// des rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

rjes gnang dngos la thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas te/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ lan gsum/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser sogs nas/ sbyangs par mos nas dbugs thog gcig la 'di'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa gcig mdzod/ dhīḥbargya rtsa gcig bzlas nas zhes brjod pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan 'dag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi mtshan nas smos te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o lan gsum/

de ltar byas pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad= /ngag rje btsun= /gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa= /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyang gis bye ste byon pa khyed rang gyi spyi bo nas thim ste/ thugs ka'i dhīḥyig dang dbyer med du gyur pa mos nas/ de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ de yang je phra je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin spros bral nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar byas pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yid kyi 'gal rkyen= sems rje btsun= des dngos gzhi grub nas/ mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes pas khas blangs nas/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa rnams kyang drin lan du 'bul/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// des rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por mdzod/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gsos nas/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar gong ltar bya'o// bcom ldan 'das bdag dang*/ sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs nas mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gnas gsum bsrung*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs brjod/ ces pa 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa chen po rdo rje 'chang bud+dha siṃ ha'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa brang ti pa'i bhik+ṣu ga ga na shrī bha dras skul pa po'i bzhed pa ltar rtse gdong klu sdings kyi gzim khang khams gsum rnam rgyal du myur bar sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser sgrub thabs gegs sel dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ shes bya'i lha lam rab yangs par// mkhyen brtse 'od stong rab 'phro ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma nyin byed kyis// bdag blo'i pad+mo rtag skyong 'tshal// 'dir mar gyur gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par byed pa la blo gros phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan dgos pas/ de nyid skyed par byed pa la'ang yi dam gyi lha re brten dgos so// de'ang de bzhin gshegs pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir 'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar ser gyi sgo nas shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byas te rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro ci nus byas la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi shes pa dhīḥyig gur gum gyi mdog 'dra ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gur gum rgyas pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings shing zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs shing zla ba la rgyab brten nas/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur par bsams la/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la yid gtad de yun ring bsgom pa bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ rang gi lce'i rtsa bar dhīḥmago phugs su bstan pa dang*/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du dhīḥyig gi mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du a ra pa tsa nas bskor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gsos btab ste/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sngon gyi smon lam bskul te mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas/ skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom ste ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad la thogs pa med par bsams la/

oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar mgrin pa'i dhīḥl dmigs pa gtad de/ dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa'am ma grub na'ang gtam gyis bar ma chod par bzlas la/ mchil ma cung zad mid pa'i rkyen gyis dhīḥyig khong par song ste rang gi lus dhīḥr gyur par bsam mo// 'dis ni gtso cher ngag gi dri ma sbyong ngo*// bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag brgyad kha skong dang bcas pa'o// thun las ldang ba'i tshe/

skad cig gi 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur par bsam/ ār+ya mañju shrī ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs sam/ rgyas par na mtshan yang dag par brjod pas kyang bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste dge ba'i rtsa ba 'gro ba'i don du spyod lam thams cad du 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o gsungs/ gong ltar mchod bstod bsdus pa dang 'dod don gsol gdab byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su gshegs gsol bya'o// de ltar zla ba drug gam 'bum phrag brgyad la sogs pas bsgrubs na/ nyams snang ngam rmi lam du ral gri dang ut+pal bzung ba dang*/ me 'bar ba dang nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa byung na grub pa'i rtags yin pas shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par 'gyur ro// gal te bar chad kyang 'byung srid pas de'i rmi lam du sprin nag 'thibs pa dang*/ thog ser 'bab pa dang*/ rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang*/ mun khung du zhugs pa dang*/ khyi sogs gcan gzan gyis zos pa la sogs pa byung na/ de nyid sel bar byed pa'i thabs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i skur bsgoms la/ thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces kha dog sngon po las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros pas bar chad thams cad bsregs par bsams la sngags de nyid brgya rtsa sogs bzlas pas nges par gegs sel 'di ni bsnyen pa gang la'ang sbyar rung bar gsungs so// sel lo// de ltar ye shes sems dpa' yi// sgrub thabs gegs sel bcas pa 'di// dpal ldan bla ma'i bran gyur pa// ban+de shrī ming can gyis bris// dge des ma gyur 'gro kun gyi// mi shes mun pa rab bsal nas// yang dag ye shes legs rtogs te// 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid gyur cig

/sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi bsnyen thabs nyung gsal bzhugs so// na mo mañju shrī ye/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa byed na/ 'di'i rjes gnang dang man ngag legs par thob pas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su phyag dar bya/ 'jam dpal gyi sku brnyan bris 'bur yod na rang la zhal phyogs nas bzhugs/ mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ rang nyid kyis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ khrus dang*/ gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pas gza' skar sbyor byed shis pa'i nyi shar nas brtsams te thun bzhi'i rim pas nyams len la 'jug sgrub thabs rje btsun gong mas mdzad pa'am/ gong ma'i gsung sor bzhag mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa sogs yig cha khungs thub ltar nyams su blangs te/ rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rtags mthong ba/ 'bring dus bsnyen zla ba drug tha ma grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag brgyad kha skong dang bcas pa bzla/ sbyin sreg dmigs bsal ma bshad pas mi dgos/ thun thams cad la bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ na mo mañju shrī ye ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ bo dhī sa twā ya/ mahā sa twā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tat+ya thā/ oṃ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ dza ya wa re/ ru ru tsa le/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs 'di'ang ci rigs par bzla bar 'phags pa rin po ches gsungs pas brgya rtsa nas nyer gcig gi bar ci nus bzla/ thun gnyis sam/ snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul/ thun mtshams rnams su mtshan brjod sogs 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa'i rigs dang maṇ+ḍal la 'bad/ bar chad kyi ltas byung na mi g.yo ba'i sgom bzlas kyis bsrung*/ de ltar brtson pas thog mar 'dzin blo skye zhing*/ rim gyis snyan ngag sogs la blo gros kyi mthu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba de nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang mañju gho ṣas bris pa dge/

༈ /'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ ye shes snang ba dam pa blo gros kyi// pad+mo rgyas mdzad 'jam dbyangs lhag pa'i lhar// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kun gyi phul// 'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung spel// gang zhig mtha' klas pa'i yid can la rjes su brtse ba'i rigs sad cing brtson 'grus dang skal bar ldan pa dag gis 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ rang gzhan thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams shing 'khyams par gyur pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni nyes pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas bdag tu lta ba cha dang bcas pa nyid yin la/ de spong bar byed pa la de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can yan lag dang bcas pa bskyed par bya ba'i slad du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo zab mo bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par mnos shing dam tshig la gnas pas/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur 'jam pa'i stan la nye bar 'jug ste/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi rim pas nyams su blang bar bya'o// de la dang po sbyor ba la/ nges 'byung dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub sems kyi dmigs pa rnams sgo du ma nas yid la byas pa'i mthar/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal btab la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa'i// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi// ci nus kyi mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la bstim/ sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' khyab yid can 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu// rmongs dang ma rig 'thibs bu bsal ba la// kun gzigs ye shes snang ba mchog thob phyir// smra ba'i nyi ma'i ting 'dzin bsgrub par bgyi// lan gsum/

sems can thams cad bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms ngang gnas pa'i// tshad med rnam bzhi'i bdud rtsis nyer 'tsho bas// phan bde'i pad+mo rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar mtshan bcas lha'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ chos kun gzod nas spros pa'i mtshan ma las 'das bzhin// rten cing 'brel 'byung sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol las// rang gi snying nyid stong gsal 'od kyi gur khang dbus// pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla steng yi ge dhīḥ /gur gum mdog 'dra yid kyi sgrib pa rnam sel ba'i// 'od kyis lus kun rab gang dag pa'i shel ltar gyur// de ma thag tu rang nyid mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// lang tsho rgyas shing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i tshul 'chang ba// gser bsregs mdog 'dra kun nas 'od rab gsal ba'i sku// sgeg cing mdzes pa'i sku ni brjid cing 'gying bag can// spyan yang zur gyis gzigs shing cung zad bzhad cing 'dzum// zur phud lnga ldan snyan gong ut+pal dar dpyangs can// rin chen cod pan 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pa'i mdzes/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ /dpa' bo thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyab tu bsil zer can// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan kun 'od 'bar ba// phyag g.yas dbang sngon mdog mtshungs shes rab ral gri 'phyar// g.yon pas ut+pal ze'u 'brus brten pa'i glegs bam bsnams// chu skyes zla dbus skyil mo krung gis legs bzhugs shing*// sna tshogs 'od kyis mkha' kun 'gengs pa'i ye shes sku// snang stong zung 'jug dbang po'i gzhu bzhin gsal bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsam la lha sku gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin/ des skyon gzungs kyi sgo bsgrub pa'i slad du bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i dbus su dhīḥyig mthar// sngon du oṃ sngags a ra pa tsa na dhīḥdang*// lce la yang ni mdzes pa'i dhīḥ

lce'i rtsa bar gre phugs su mgo bstan pa/ yig gis mtshan te// de ltar yi ge'i tshogs kun rin chen sgron me ltar// rab tu gsal zhing 'bar ba las byung 'od zer gyis// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa kun bsal zhing*// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i go 'phang bkod// sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam rjes bskul nas// mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od zer rnam pas rang la thim// thog med sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa sbyangs byas te// ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i yul la rab 'jug pa'i// gzungs dang blo gros spobs pa'i gter chen grol bar gyur// ces bzlas dmigs dang bcas oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes g.yeng ba dang bral ba'i yid kyis ci tsam nus pa bzla/ spro na/ na mo mañju shrī ye ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā yā/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tat+ya thā/ oṃ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ dza ya wa re/ ru ru tsa le/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs 'di nyid kyang ci rigs par bzla'o// thun 'jog pa'i dus su/ lce'i rtsa ba'i dhī la dmigs te dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad dam/ de ltar ma grub na'ang gtam gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzlas pa'i mthar mchil ma cung zad mid pa'i rkyen gyis dhīḥyig khong par song bas rang gi lus dhīḥdamar ser 'od 'bar bar gyur pa la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas kyang bzla bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ slar yang rang skad cig gis 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skur gyur par bsams la mchod pa ni so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ legs bris bdag po'i btung ba la sbyar ba'i// yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mchod yon gyis// 'phags mchog zhal gyi pad+mor bsnyen bkur na// snying rje lang tsho rdzogs pa'i bka' drin stsol// oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

rnyog pa'i dri ma gzhar yang mi mdza' ba'i// dag byed gaṅgā'i rgyun gyi reg bya yis// zhabs mthil 'khor lo'i re khā bsil ba las// stong nyid zab mo'i ngal 'tsho thob par mdzod// pā d+yaṃ/ 'chi med bu mo'i khengs pa 'phrog byed pa'i// sna tshogs me tog gzhon nu'i gru char gyis// nor bu'i zur phud mdzes pa'i skabs ster bas// mtha' yas sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i phun tshogs las// byung ba'i bsung zhim dngar po'i sprin phung gis// 'jam mgon dri 'dzin dgyes pa'i legs byas mthus// 'phags rnams rab dga'i tshul khrims dag par shog /dhū pe/ mun pa'i 'thibs bu bsnyil 'od rno ldan pa// nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i snang gsal gyis// ye shes gzigs pa'i mdun sar mdzes ster bas// mi 'khrugs bzod pa'i go cha brtan par shog /ā lo ke/ gdung sel zla ba gzhon nu'i bsil 'od can// ga bur tsan+dan gur gum dri yi chus// bsod nams bye ba'i phung por byugs pa'i mthus// tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i brtson 'grus mthar phyin shog /gan+dhe/ skabs gsum dbang po'i btung ba las lhag pa'i// bza' bca' btung ba'i khyad par rnam mang po// ljags kyi pad+mar sim pa'i dge mtshan las// 'gro kun bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /nai wi d+ya/ dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgeg 'chang ba// snyan 'gyur rol mo'i mchod sprin sbyar ba las// sa gsum ma rig gnyid las slong bgyid pa'i// shes rab mchog gi sgra dbyangs len par shog /shab+da/ zhes pa'am bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod/ rgyas par na mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha dang*/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa sogs tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i bstod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// ye shes phung po gcig bsdus par// 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes mtshan gsol bar// dad pas cung zad bsngags par bgyi/1

/gang khyod rig dang brtse ba yi// legs spyad mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mthus// srid zhi'i spros pa brtul mdzad nas// byang chub snying po'i thig ler mdzes/2 /gzhan du 'gro ba drang ba'i slad// ji snyed rgyal rnams mdun sa ru// byang sems khyu mchog chen po'i tshul// smra ba'i nyi ma'ang de snyed snang*/3 /khyod sku mchog tu dwangs pa'i shel// gur gum sar pas mdangs mtshungs kyang*// mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar mtha' yas kyis// srid na dpe zlas dben par byas/4 /gsung gi nor bu'i rgyud mangs po// yan lag drug cu'i nyams 'gyur can// shes bya kun dang sbyor ba na// sa gsum snyan pa'i khengs pa 'phrog5 /gzhar yang spros pa las 'das pa'i// ji lta'i ye shes thugs chud bzhin// ji snyed mkhyen pa'i sgeg 'chang bas// 'phags bzhi'i 'byung nas gcig tu gyur/6 /mdor na bral dang smin pa yi// phul byung yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshul// blo ldan bye bas bskal pa brgyar// bsngags kyang cha tsam mtshon nus min/7 /yid can kun la mngon mtho dang*// nges legs rnam mkhyen lam ston pa'i// phrin las mkha' dang snyoms 'jug pa// 'khor ba srid du mthor mi mngon/8 /phyogs bcu'i rgyal yang nyin bzhin du// khyed la bstod pa'i lhur byed na// e ma gang gi rnam thar la// su zhig gus pa skye mi 'gyur/9 /de slad 'dir yang rtse gcig pa'i// dad pas mchod cing gsol 'debs na// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// thugs rje 'bab stegs nyid du mdzod/10 /tshul gnas khrims kyi dga' tshal du// mang du thos pa'i pad+mo'i rdzing*// bsam byung mtshar sdug dar babs shing*// sgom pa'i 'bras bu dud gyur cig11 /phyi nang rig gzhung chu gter che// 'phel byed 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi// bdud rtsi'i zer brgyas yongs gang ba// smra ba'i zla ba nyid gyur cig12 /lhag par zab mo'i rig sngags grub pas 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal mthong zhing*// gsung gi zil dngar yang yang stsol bas blo gros lang tsho rdzogs pa'i mthus// bdag dang phung po rnam rig las 'das stong dang rten 'byung mi phyed pa'i// kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba gsar pas sa gsum dge legs sbyin gyur cig

/ces bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa'am/ bsdu na/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal gzhon nu 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams rnams su'ang 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bas tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel ba la bslab par bya'o// bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas thun bzhi'i sbyor bas rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa nyams dang rmi lam du ral gri dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ me 'bar ba/ nyi zla shar ba sogs rtags ma byung gi bar du 'bad/ 'bring dus bsnyen zla ba drug tha ma grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag brgyad kha skong dang bcas pa bzla'o// de dag gi skabs su rmi lam du thog ser 'bab pa dang*/ rlung nag 'khrugs pa dang*/ gcan gzan gyis zos pa sogs byung na cung zad bar chad kyi rtags yin pas/ thun mtshams rnams su khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la skad cig gis/ rang nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo sngon po spyan gsum 'bar// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams// ye shes me dbus pus g.yon btsugs pa'i stabs kyis rol// khro bo'i chas rdzogs thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su hūm̐// mtha' skor sngags phreng dbang sngon mdog mtshungs bskor ba las// rab 'bar me 'od tsha zhing rtsub par 'phros pa yis// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun bsregs shing sbyangs par gyur// oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brgya stong sogs bzla/ spro na chu srung gi gdams pa'ang nyams su blangs pas 'phral du zhi bar 'gyur la/ gegs sel 'di lhag pa'i lha gang la'ang sbyar du rung ngo*// de ltar rtse gcig tu 'bad pas thog mar 'dzin pa'i blo skye zhing*/ de nas snyan ngag dang*/

rdo rje'i ngag dang*/ phyin ci log pa'i don phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyes nas gzungs dang spobs pa'i mthu zla bas reg pa'i chu gter bzhin du 'phel bar 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs phul// sa skya'i 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal lung rnams// shin tu gsal bar bkod 'dis yid can kun// blo gros snang ba mchog tu rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang mngon rtogs kyi dngos gzhi rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab sor bzhag la/ tshig gi mtha' bskyed tshul dang*/ sbyor rjes kyi spros pa cung zad dang bcas te mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun chos rab rnam 'byed kyi blo mchog zab mos byang chub snying po'i go 'phang la myur du reg pa'i rgyur sid+dhi rastu/ sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// brtan pa'i 'khor lo grub chen dze tā ri// rol pa'i rdo rje don yod rdo rje dang*// ba ri lo tsā 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpal// kun dga' snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// smra ba'i dbang phyug rgwa lo yab sras dang*// grags pa seng ge rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// dkon mchog lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' dpal bzang bsod nams lhun grub dang*// ngag dbang bstan rdor bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang*// bkra shis dpal ldan kun dga' rin chen zhabs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams dpal ldan dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// rin chen mchog grub nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar mi phyed gus pas gsol btab mthus// bdag gzhan 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar// dal 'byor rten thob dge ba'i bshes kyis bzung*// rnam dag bstan la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// khyad par smin byed dbang dang rjes gnang gis// rgyud smin zab mo'i sngags rig grub pa las// 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal bzang mthong ba dang*// gsung gi bdud rtsi thob par byin gyis rlobs// de mthus khas blangs tshul khrims rnam par dag

/dad dang nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis 'byong*// phul byung zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros dang*// spobs pa'i gter chen grol bar byin gyis rlobs// mang du thos pa'i dpag bsam rab rgyas par// bsam byung dag pa'i pad+mo mdzes 'bar zhing*// don sgom nor bu'i snye ma g.yur za bas// phan bde'i 'dod pa 'jo bar byin= /tshig snyan sdeb legs sbyor bas rab bcings shing*// don bzang rin chen bye ba'i dpal 'dzin pa// rtsom phreng thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig pu// srid mtha'i bar du 'phel bar byin= /phyi nang rig gzhung mtha' dag 'khrul med par// dgos bsdus tshig don mtshams sbyor brgal lan gyis// 'chad pas blo gsal rgya mtsho'i yid 'phrog pa'i// smra ba'i dbang phyug thob par byin= /gzhal bya'i gnas kun mngon sum rjes dpag gis// bsgrub dang sun 'byin tsher ma dbyung mkhas pa'i// rtsod pas phas rgol phyogs las rnam rgyal pa'i// grags dkar sa gsum khyab par byin= /mthar thug shes bya'i chos kun ji bzhin mthong*// shes pa spros bral zhi ba'i dbyings su sim// shes dang shes bya ro gcig 'jam pa'i dpal// tshe 'dir mngon sum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las chos tshul 'di'i bka' drin mang du thob pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mi phyed gus pas gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
